items.title: Meet the bass and its job — practical study
instructions: Point to each named part on your instrument.
Say E, A, D, G from thickest to thinnest without looking.
Pluck each open string once and describe which sounds lowest.
completion_criteria: Identify the four strings and six instrument parts correctly.

items.title: Connect the bass and set a simple sound — practical study
instructions: Connect with the amplifier muted or volume down.
Play four gentle notes and increase volume gradually.
Change one tone control, listen, then return it to the starting setting.
completion_criteria: Connect and disconnect quietly and find a comfortable clean sound.

items.title: Support the instrument and relax — practical study
instructions: Sit with the bass balanced and briefly release both hands while keeping it secure.
Stand with the strap adjusted and compare your wrist angles.
Play slowly for thirty seconds, relax, and check for gripping tension.
completion_criteria: Play briefly with relaxed shoulders and without gripping the neck for support.

items.title: Tune to E1–A1–D2–G2 — practical study

Tune each open string in small steps while muting the other strings.

completion_criteria: Tune all four strings to the correct note and octave with a tuner.

items.title: Make a controlled fingerstyle note — practical study
instructions: Play four open E notes with your index finger.
Repeat with your middle finger at similar volume.
Play the linked pattern slowly and listen for harsh attacks.
completion_criteria: Produce eight clear notes at similar volume without excess tension.

score.playback: synthesized practice tone; not a realistic technique demonstration

items.title: Alternate index and middle fingers — practical study

score.playback: synthesized practice tone; not a realistic technique demonstration

items.title: Fret a note with light pressure — practical study

score.playback: synthesized practice tone; not a realistic technique demonstration
